caution_findings.reason: Database rows that omit or abstract noncanonical primary-source modifications were preserved as sequence_modified_not_normalized/source_conflict rather than exact source_verified.
CAMP/dbAMP entry-level rows include targets from other publication contexts; unsupported target strings were not promoted to primary evidence.
The local supplementary .bin assets are HTML landing/article/redirect pages; no extra structured values were recoverable or required.
Mechanism layer is bounded to structure-activity inference because this paper has no direct mechanism assay.
